text: The brain_v9 FastAPI backend uses two auth levels: OperatorAccess and StrictOperatorAccess. StrictOperatorAccess requires an exact X-Brain-Token match using compare_digest and does NOT allow localhost bypass. The BRAIN_ENABLE_UNSAFE_DEV_ENDPOINTS config variable defaults to false. The /dev and /godmode endpoints are gated by both the flag and StrictOperatorAccess. No mutative endpoint should be reachable without StrictOperatorAccess.
